detail.longDescription: I saw a post here on Mastodon last night about # accessibility in # WebDev and # Software and about how often even the most basic of basics like navigating via keyboard doesn't work. It really sat in my mind all night. When I read it I immediately added a task to my current small re-design project to do a review and spend time working on accessibility. Already found some things... 🧵 # A11y # programming
